title: Plan language 1.3
description: A closed, versioned test plan. Every assertion names the acceptance criterion it checks. A plan declaring "1.1" or "1.2" may use only what that version had. The unsafe features of "1.3" (CSS and XPath locators, DOM checks, page scripts and database commands) parse only when the trusted project enables each one, and a run using any of them is labelled unsafe. Fitting this schema is necessary, not sufficient: the plan parser also checks the project's allow-list, matrix, declared secrets, fixtures, test-id attributes and email domains, its limits, its text safety rules that every value and download is defined before it is used, that a second tab and a call stand only at the top level, and that each call, stub, observed request, storage entry, argument and field is one the project declares.
